nom: Vichy LiftActiv Collagen Specialist 16 Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin or sensitive eyes report the cream does not irritate, sting, or interfere with contact lens wear.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin, aged 40, describes the cream as very hydrating with no pilling under makeup and no itching, unlike some other eye creams she has tried.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on fine lines and wrinkles report smoother, firmer-looking skin and softer crow's feet with weeks of daily use, though several 3-star reviews report no meaningful lifting or line reduction after 30 days to a month.
concerns.spots: Reviewers focused on dark circles report mixed results: several describe a brighter, less discolored under-eye area after consistent use, but one reviewer explains that dark circles caused by hollows rather than pigmentation are unlikely to improve with any eye cream, and a few others report no noticeable change to their circles.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the cream keeps the under-eye area hydrated without heaviness or pilling under concealer, which is the most consistently confirmed benefit across both positive and critical reviews.

aspects.libelle: Has a noticeable scent that some find unpleasant
Precise applicator tip controls the amount dispensed
Lightweight texture absorbs quickly without pilling under makeup
Small tube relative to the price

extraits.texte: I used this product daily for over a month. I cannot say that I noticed a huge difference in the appearance of my under eyes, but it did improve moisture and did not irritate my skin or eyes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My dark circles are bad, but they are caused by hollows, so I don't expect any eye cream to fix that. I have minimal under eye wrinkles, so the main thing I look for in an eye cream is that it's moisturizing and it doesn't interfere with my concealer. If you don't have under eyes like the Sahara, this may be great, but I had to use another eye cream over it. Luckily, it absorbs quickly and it did play well with the eye cream I layered over it. I used it for about 40 days and it feels like I have about half left, but I can't be sure. If you have normal dark circles and need normal hydration, this will probably work great, but for my needs I think I'll pass.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Super cute packaging and I loved the applicator. With that being said, I don't think it did much for my eye sagging. I do have naturally hooded eyes however after 30 days I did not see any noticeable lifting. You do get a pretty large tube for the amount you need so if it does work for you, it will last a while which is why I gave it 3 stars and not less. Sadly, it just wasn't my favorite.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed the consistency of this eye cream. Out of the bottle it is thick and holds its shape. Doesn't slide all over your eyes. Dries down fairly mat, which I appreciate. And stays in place. The only thing I didn't love about this product is that it is fragrance. The scent fades after the product dries down, but in general, I prefer product without fragrance. As it can be irritating. I did not notice any difference in puffiness, but did they get helped hydrate my under eyes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product but you absolutely have to use it everyday long term to start seeing results. It's not fast acting. It's easy to apply slightly thick feeling. It's sticky and a little heavy but the appearance over time is great. Less wrinkles, very moisturized. Thickening the skin in the under eye area helps the dark circles I have. Stick to it and you will see great results.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the VICHY Collagen Specialist 16 Eye Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm blown away with the results! This rich and luxurious eye cream has significantly reduced the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes, leaving my skin looking smoother and more radiant!! The formula is incredibly hydrating, absorbing quickly and easily into the delicate skin around my eyes without leaving any greasy residue whatsoever. I've also noticed an improvement in the dark circles and puffiness under my eyes, making me look more rested and refreshed!! What more could we ask for?!?! The cream is gentle and non-irritating, making it perfect for even the most sensitive skin!! I'm obsessed with the effectiveness and quality of this eye cream, and would highly recommend it to anyone looking to address concerns around the delicate eye area, like me!!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm 40 and have dry skin. This eye cream is so hydrating! There's no pilling under the makeup, and I feel like it just makes my skin bouncier and healthier. I totally recommend it! I've tried some eye creams that make the skin around my eyes itch a bit, but I don't feel anything with this product, which is a huge plus. Overall, I recommend it!
